decision_summary: The repository may continue publishing source-labelled non-composite indicators, but it is not ready to publish a project-authored national status label, national risk level or composite score.

coverage_readiness.rationale: Product-day and aggregate snapshot evidence exists, but national current outage coverage, terminal capacity and reusable live vessel/cargo coverage do not.

freshness_readiness.rationale: Repository validation separates manual and generated staleness, but no approved model-specific freshness window exists for every proposed critical input and 17 stale warnings remain.

methodology_readiness.rationale: The existing five-band 0-100 draft conflicts with the four-state issue, and no approved normalisation, weighting, transition or sensitivity method exists.

rights_readiness.rationale: Current registered evidence carries rights metadata, but a final contributing input set is not approved and live shipping/terminal candidates do not provide a complete reusable path.

operational_readiness.rationale: The repository has validation and deployment controls, but it has no approved status computation, transition test suite, historical replay or generated run evidence for a model.

communication_readiness.rationale: The UI correctly shows the model as unavailable and maintains claim boundaries, but no approved explanation exists for future score movement, uncertainty, conflicts or omitted inputs.

thresholds.rationale: An unknown source mode makes coverage and evidence handling non-reconcilable.
thresholds.measurement_method: Count source-manifest fetch values outside programmatic, manual, derived and unavailable.
thresholds.sensitivity_justification: Relaxing this invariant by even one would allow evidence to disappear from defined source-mode handling; zero is a schema invariant, not empirical calibration.
thresholds.failure_behavior: Block all project-authored status or score publication.

thresholds.rationale: Every registered source must reconcile to a generated or manual evidence envelope, including explicit unavailable envelopes.
thresholds.measurement_method: Count source-manifest entries where both has_generated and has_manual are false.
thresholds.sensitivity_justification: Allowing a missing envelope would make the source's status and caveats unknowable; zero follows the repository evidence contract.
thresholds.failure_behavior: Block all project-authored status or score publication.

thresholds.rationale: A public composite cannot lawfully or reproducibly depend on an input whose display, transformation or redistribution rights are unresolved.
thresholds.measurement_method: Count proposed contributing inputs without an approved rights record covering the intended model use.
thresholds.sensitivity_justification: Any non-zero allowance would knowingly publish a result derived from rights-uncertain evidence; zero is a publication precondition.
thresholds.failure_behavior: Keep the model unavailable and identify the affected input.

thresholds.rationale: A critical input outside its approved source-specific freshness window cannot support a current national label.
thresholds.measurement_method: Evaluate each approved critical input against its source-specific reviewed or retrieved date and freshness window.
thresholds.sensitivity_justification: The allowed count is zero because a critical input is, by definition, one whose absence or staleness invalidates the current label; critical-input designation itself remains subject to methodology approval.
thresholds.failure_behavior: Suppress the label and show the stale input rather than reweighting remaining evidence.

thresholds.rationale: Every derived contribution must have a documented formula, aligned fields and tests before it can affect a public model.
thresholds.measurement_method: Count proposed derived inputs without formula documentation, parent provenance and calculation tests.
thresholds.sensitivity_justification: Allowing one unvalidated transformation would make score movement irreproducible; zero is a methodology invariant.
thresholds.failure_behavior: Exclude the model from publication; do not silently drop or reweight the input.

thresholds.rationale: The repository has unlike state systems and no defensible denominator that makes site, population or jurisdiction coverage equivalent.
thresholds.measurement_method: Unresolved: first define the national denominator, product scope, station universe and treatment of voluntary or delayed schemes.
thresholds.sensitivity_justification: No sensitivity analysis is possible until comparable jurisdiction data and a defensible denominator exist; assigning a percentage now would fabricate precision.
thresholds.failure_behavior: Keep national availability and composite claims unavailable.

thresholds.rationale: No approved component set or weights exist, so an unavailable-input percentage cannot yet be measured honestly.
thresholds.measurement_method: Unresolved: approve components and non-adaptive weights before calculating unavailable weight.
thresholds.sensitivity_justification: A numeric limit without approved weights would permit silent reweighting and materially different results from the same missing inputs.
thresholds.failure_behavior: Keep the model unavailable; never convert unavailable weight to zero or redistribute it.

thresholds.rationale: Candidate inputs have different cadences, revisions and history lengths, and no baseline study establishes the periods needed for stable transitions.
thresholds.measurement_method: Unresolved: construct aligned candidate histories, test missingness and revisions, and measure transition stability over alternative windows.
thresholds.sensitivity_justification: The required period count must follow replay and sensitivity evidence; selecting one now would be arbitrary.
thresholds.failure_behavior: Block any historical normalisation, percentile threshold or public composite.

thresholds.rationale: Source independence cannot be quantified until components, publisher lineage and weights are approved.
thresholds.measurement_method: Unresolved: trace each component to ultimate publishers and calculate direct and derived weight by publisher.
thresholds.sensitivity_justification: A cap must be tested against the actual input graph; a guessed percentage would not establish independence.
thresholds.failure_behavior: Keep source-independence readiness blocked and show publisher concentration explicitly.

thresholds.rationale: Cadence alone does not establish how old each operational input may be before a current national claim fails.
thresholds.measurement_method: Unresolved: document one window per approved critical source using publication cadence, expected delay and revision behavior.
thresholds.sensitivity_justification: One global age or an invented number would treat weekly, monthly, quarterly and manual evidence as falsely comparable.
thresholds.failure_behavior: Suppress the model when any critical source lacks an approved window or exceeds it.

blocking_conditions.summary: The five-band 0-100 draft conflicts with the four-state model requested by issue #37.
blocking_conditions.condition_to_clear: Approve one named output, band vocabulary and claim scope; archive or reconcile the conflicting draft.

blocking_conditions.summary: No verified live reusable national station-outage feed is loaded.
blocking_conditions.condition_to_clear: Load validated current outage evidence with declared geography and products, or approve a non-national claim whose exclusions are explicit.

blocking_conditions.summary: No current public production-safe terminal-capacity or inventory series is loaded.
blocking_conditions.condition_to_clear: Load a dated, rights-safe capacity source with precise identity, units and product scope, or narrow and approve a model that does not claim terminal resilience.

blocking_conditions.summary: Aggregate tanker context is public, but no live vessel/cargo path has verified redistribution rights and cargo evidence.
blocking_conditions.condition_to_clear: Approve a rights-safe source and field-level observed/reported/inferred rules, or constrain the claim to dated aggregate shipping context.

blocking_conditions.summary: The national Fuel Plan statistics evidence is reviewed manually; no stable machine-readable publication contract is registered.
blocking_conditions.condition_to_clear: Establish a stable official machine-readable source or approve a fail-closed reviewed extraction contract with fixtures and explicit manual-source freshness.

blocking_conditions.summary: No approved model-specific maximum age exists for every proposed critical source.
blocking_conditions.condition_to_clear: Approve source-specific windows with cadence/revision rationale, tests and fail-closed stale behavior.

blocking_conditions.summary: No aligned historical replay establishes normalisation or stable transition behavior.
blocking_conditions.condition_to_clear: Build a provenance-preserving historical input set and publish replay, revision and alternative-window sensitivity results.

blocking_conditions.summary: No approved, implemented and tested rule exists for every status transition or score movement.
blocking_conditions.condition_to_clear: Approve rules, implement them separately, and test every boundary, stale input, conflict and missing-data transition.

blocking_conditions.summary: Geographic, product and unavailable-weight thresholds lack a defensible denominator and sensitivity analysis.
blocking_conditions.condition_to_clear: Define comparable denominators and approve evidence-backed thresholds after sensitivity analysis.

blocking_conditions.summary: Dependence on one ultimate publisher has not been measured against an approved component graph.
blocking_conditions.condition_to_clear: Approve components, trace publisher lineage through derived inputs and publish concentration sensitivity.

blocking_conditions.summary: No reviewed methodology approval records the final input set, weights, uncertainty, conflicts and communication rules.
blocking_conditions.condition_to_clear: Complete independent methodology review and record explicit approval before implementation or publication.

fuel_availability_status.rationale: Current state outage evidence is partial, delayed or unavailable and has no approved national denominator.

fuel_security_status.rationale: Official snapshot indicators may be shown individually, but a project-authored current security label lacks complete coverage and rules.

supply_chain_status.rationale: Only dated aggregate shipping context is defensible; live vessel, cargo and route evidence is rights- or evidence-blocked.

resilience_status.rationale: A broad resilience claim would overreach current outage, terminal, shipping, independence and historical evidence.

national_risk_level.rationale: No approved risk construct, baseline, transition logic or coverage threshold exists.

composite_national_score.rationale: The proposed component set, weights, thresholds, historical baseline, source independence and approval are unresolved.

claim_boundary: Passing this gate would not mean that any Australian government endorses the model.
Passing this gate would not prove that every upstream source is correct.
Passing this gate would not prove that all private fuel stocks are known.
Passing this gate would not prove that every terminal is covered.
Passing this gate would not prove that all disruptions are visible.
Passing this gate would not mean that the result predicts shortages.
Passing this gate would not make the result an official security assessment.
